page.title: Trust and privacy
page.description: What {name} may do without asking, and what it knows.
page.rules_intro: Every rule here came from an approval card you answered with “Always allow”. Revoke one and the next such action asks again.
page.rules_empty: Nothing yet. {name} asks before every consequential action.
page.agent_rules_intro: A rule saved on an agent applies to that agent’s work only.
page.limits_intro: No rule, setting or routine can lift these.
page.limit_money: Moving money: payments, purchases, transfers, trades.
page.limit_new_recipient: Writing in your name to someone you never wrote to from here.
page.recipients_intro: A first message to anyone else asks you first.

privacy.title: What {name} knows and where it goes
privacy.learned_intro: Things you said and things it noticed, kept on this computer.
privacy.leaves_intro: Each role runs on the provider named. A cloud provider receives what its role needs: your words and the text it answers.
privacy.screen_intro: One capture of the screen under your cursor, only when you ask for it, then dropped.
privacy.screen_switch: May look at the screen when you ask
